S1.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
S1.answer:
- **Get Clássica:** Free rental at R$ 10,000/month in sales, otherwise R$ 79,90/month. It has a 3G chip, Wi-Fi and a receipt printer, and accepts contactless and Pix via QR Code. Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-tap-03-11-25/ and https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/
- **Get Smart:** Free rental at R$ 60,000/month in sales, otherwise R$ 129,90/month. It integrates the order with the payment, has a 3G chip with a free data plan and Wi-Fi, and accepts contactless and Pix via QR Code. Source: https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/
- Get Smart also runs Android and can integrate an API suited to your business. Source: https://www.getnet.net/en/our-solutions/in-person-payments

S4.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
S4.answer:
Yes. To sell with Pix on the Get Tap, you must enable the feature and link a bank account through the Getnet Brasil app (Services > "Venda com Pix" > "Habilitar" > choose your bank and follow the on-screen steps). The linked account is the one that receives the Pix payments.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix-no-get-tap-mais-agilidade-e-eficiencia-das-vendas/

S5.answer:
Your terminal (GS-77A1) is offline and was last seen on 2026-11-13 at 14:10. It is on Wi-Fi with a weak signal, which is the most visible issue. Battery is 42%, and firmware 4.2.1 is out of date (4.3.0 is available).

If it still won't connect, I can open a ticket for our human team to look at the connection problem. Just tell me the priority you'd like.

S6.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
S6.answer:
Advance (antecipação) lets you receive credit card sales (lump-sum or installments) before the original scheduled date, for a fee. It is not a loan, since you get money that is already yours and take on no new debt.
In the Getnet Brasil app, you can check available receivables, simulate, and see the net amount before confirming.
On the Get Smart terminal: Pagamento > Antecipação > merchant password > choose the card brand > Antecipar > enter the code from the earlier consultation. The terminal confirms it and prints a receipt.
Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf

S9.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
S9.answer:
With Crediário Getnet you can split a sale into up to 48 installments. The maximum number varies by the card-issuing bank: for example, Santander offers up to 48x, while other banks offer up to 24x (subject to change). The customer needs enough available credit limit on their card to cover the full purchase amount.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Folder_Credirio.pdf

S10.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
S10.answer:
Yes. Getnet's Payment Link lets you generate a customizable link and send it via WhatsApp, social networks, email, or any other digital channel. The customer clicks it and pays by credit card, debit, or Pix, with no need for a physical terminal or online store.
